verdict.rationale: Hummingbird's help center documents its own APIs: an Alerts API, a Case API for creating and updating cases, list and fetch endpoints, batch case import, and filing APIs to validate, file and monitor status. API keys are managed in organization settings, so the product can be driven programmatically. However, the actual developer reference at docs.hummingbird.co is entirely password-gated, and no public OpenAPI spec, reference, sandbox or versioning docs were found, so the API is only documented publicly at overview level. Missing for 10: a publicly accessible API reference, an OpenAPI/Swagger spec, auth/endpoint detail, versioning docs, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
